import openpyxl, os
wb = openpyxl.load_workbook(os.environ['OUT_XLSX'])
ws = wb.active
# items in B2:B5 excluding A2
exclude = ws['A2'].value
items = [ws.cell(row=r, column=2).value for r in range(2,6)]
result = [x for x in items if x != exclude]
for r in range(2,6):
    ws.cell(row=r, column=3).value = result[r-2] if r-2 < len(result) else None
wb.save(os.environ['OUT_XLSX'])
print(result)
